name: Kale Salad with Pork Sausage, Grapes, Pumpkin Seeds & Cheddar

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 bunches kale
0.45 kg red grapes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, juice lemons into a large bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 10-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add oil, honey, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the lemon juice; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage the dressing into the kale.
Halve grapes and add to the bowl with the kale.
Small dice cheese and set aside for serving.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into bite-sized rounds.
Add sausage and pumpkin seeds to the bowl with the kale; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with diced cheese. Enjoy!
